parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID associated with the collector.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the returned results. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 500.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description:
The type of machine on which the collector is deployed. If this parameter is not specified, all types are returned. Valid values:

- ECS: ECS instance

- ACK: Container Kubernetes cluster
